title: Timeline CSS Generator
description: Build a vertical timeline from your events — live preview plus copy-ready HTML and CSS.
howto: Enter one event per line (e.g. "2021 — Product launch").
Pick the accent color and card style.
Copy the code or download the self-contained timeline.html file.

faqs.q: How should I format the events?
faqs.a: One per line. Put the date first, then a dash (–, — or -), then the event text. Lines without a dash still work — the whole line becomes the event text.
Yes. The generated CSS keeps a single-column vertical timeline that works on mobile and desktop.

faqs.q: Can I use it inside an existing page?
faqs.a: Yes — copy the markup and the <style> block into your page. Class names are prefixed with tl- to avoid collisions.
A complete standalone timeline.html file with the styles embedded, ready to open in a browser.
